ÀLÁÁFÌA — CONTENT KIT, 3 LOOKS

All three stay in the kit. Pick whichever fits the message that day; the day's actual figure gets built when its slot comes up on the calendar (content/PLAYBOOK.md, ~2/week, Sep 2026 → Jan 2027).

CONSTANT across all three so it still reads as one account: the ÀLÁÁFÌA wordmark, the footer bar (source · alaafia.ng · date), the kicker (ARCHETYPE · NN), the ward-mesh / low-poly map motif, the mono p-code tags. Everything else — palette, type, composition — is the look you chose for that post.
SIGNAL.  Near-black ground, electric mint + hot coral, mono p-code chrome, telemetry feel. Highest contrast in a fast feed. Use for: build logs, launches, anything that should feel live.

FIELD ATLAS.  Warm paper, sienna accent, serif display, registration marks + marginalia. FT / Reuters-graphics rigor — the uncertainty is the aesthetic. Use for: maps of the week, methodology explainers, anything that needs to feel rigorous.

BOLD NIGERIA.  Maximalist poster — flat green/amber blocks, ward-mesh pattern, huge Bricolage display. Feels like a movement, very shareable. Use for: the thesis, one-number posts, milestones — the loud moments.
